## MarkdownFeature class

The [MarkdownFeature](./api-documenter.markdownfeature.md) abstract class extends the `MarkdownDocumenterFeature` class, allowing `onInitialized`<!-- -->, `onBeforeWritePage`<!-- -->, and `onFinished` handlers to be defined via configuration without subclassing.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare abstract class MarkdownFeature extends MarkdownDocumenterFeature 
```
**Extends:** MarkdownDocumenterFeature

## Example


```ts
import { MarkdownFeature } from "@positron/api-documenter";

const feature = MarkdownFeature.definition("my-feature", {
  onBeforeWritePage: ({ content }) => {
    // do something with page

    return content;
  },

  onFinished: (pages) => {
    console.log(pages.size);
    // >> the number of processed pages
  },
});

export const apiDocumenterPluginManifest = {
  features: [feature],
};
```
